news.t: Farrell picks side to 'back up' South Africa win
news.sum: Ireland head coach Andy Farrell believes the Nations Championship can be good preparation for next year's World Cup.

news.t: Farrell questions severity of Sheehan punishment
news.sum: Andy Farrell believes Dan Sheehan's suspension merited a lighter punishment but has come to terms with the absence of his stand-in captain for Friday night's Nations Championship finale against Australia.

news.t: Ireland's Stockdale returns as Beale, 37, back for Wallabies
news.sum: Ulster wing Jacob Stockdale is recalled to the Ireland starting team for Friday night's Nations Championship fifth-place play-off match against Australia.

news.t: Stockdale and Timoney come in for Wallabies clash
news.sum: Jacob Stockdale and Nick Timoney will start for Ireland in Friday's final Nations Championship clash with Australia, while Tadhg Beirne will take over captaincy in the absence of the suspended Dan Sheehan.

news.t: Fisilau starts as England change five for All Blacks rematch
news.sum: Exeter back row Greg Fisilau will make his first England start in one of five changes to their XV to face New Zealand on Saturday.

news.t: All Blacks great Beauden Barrett close to Bristol move
news.sum: New Zealand great Beauden Barrett is close to agreeing a deal to join Bristol Bears in what would be one of the highest-profile signings in Prem history.

news.t: Composure, accuracy, and how Ireland beat the Springboks
news.sum: Neil Treacy is joined by Johne Murphy and Greg McWilliams as we break down how Ireland produced their best performance of the season to beat South Africa 20-17 at Aviva Stadium.

news.t: Citing hearing was 'extra stress' for Prendergast
news.sum: Ireland's Sam Prendergast says head coach Andy Farrell was "unbelievably supportive" while the fly-half waited to find out whether he would be available to face South Africa last weekend.

news.t: How Fin Smith's carrying is giving England an extra dimension
news.sum: Fin Smith is only 5ft 10in tall and less than 14 stone, but the fly-half has become one of England's most prolific ball carriers.

news.t: Wales need strong finish to campaign - Morgan
news.sum: Jac Morgan believes Wales have had a positive Nations Championshipb, but says they must finish strongly against Japan.

news.t: Sheehan out of Wallabies Test after two-game ban
news.sum: Ireland's stand-in captain Dan Sheehan will be banned for two games after a croc-roll tackle against South Africa and will play no part against Australia on Friday night.

news.t: Ireland's Sheehan hit with a two-week suspension
news.sum: Ireland captain Dan Sheehan will miss Ireland's Nations Championship play-off with Australia on Friday after he was handed a two-week ban for his red-card offence during Ireland's 20-17 victory over South Africa.

news.t: Prendergast: 'I'd like to think I've thick enough skin'
news.sum: In the long list of improvements Ireland have made between their last two games against the Springboks, the most important one is the value of composure.

news.t: A world-class winger - Louis Rees-Zammit 2.0
news.sum: Wales wing Louis Rees-Zammit may not have made the cut in American football, but his gridiron crucible has seen him reformed as an improved version on his rugby union return.

news.t: Saracens prop Clarey agrees two-year deal
news.sum: Saracens prop Alec Clarey, labelled an "outstanding character" by head coach Joe Shaw, signs a new two-year contract.

news.t: O'Toole relishing role on Ireland's 'Tom Squad'
news.sum: Ireland's Tom O'Toole believes coming on in his side's narrow victory over back-to-back world champions South Africa represents the "ultimate challenge" for a prop.

news.t: Women's smaller ball trial extended into second season
news.sum: World Rugby extends the women's 4.5 ball trial for a second season after releasing data showing improvements in several areas of the game and receiving "overwhelmingly positive" feedback from players and coaches.

news.t: Former Ireland Under-20 player Byrne signs AFL contract
news.sum: Former Ireland Under-20 Irish rugby international and Dublin minor footballer Noah Byrne has signed a rookie contract with AFL side Brisbane Lions.

news.t: Coventry and Worcester express Prem interest on own terms
news.sum: Champ clubs Coventry and Warriors confirm interest in Prem places - but not if it puts their clubs at financial risk.

news.t: Ireland's rediscovered identity key to their resurgence
news.sum: Ireland's victory over South Africa and their performances throughout the Nations Championship have been marked by the return of a distinct identity to their playing strategy.

news.t: Ireland v Australia clash faces half-empty Twickenham
news.sum: Ireland's play-off clash with Australia could be played in front of a half-empty Twickenham as sluggish ticket sales look set to blight the first night of the Nations Championship finals this weekend.

news.t: Rugby Union Weekly
news.sum: Ugo, Danny and Ashy talk watchalongs, plus statement wins for Ireland and England.

news.t: England's Freeman in contention for All Blacks rematch
news.sum: England wing Tommy Freeman is in contention for Saturday's Nations Championship play-off meeting with New Zealand.

news.t: O'Toole revelling role in Ireland's 'Tom Squad'
news.sum: Ireland's Tom O'Toole on beating the Springboks, growing into his role at loosehead prop, and being part of Ireland's 'Tom Squad'.

news.t: Rennie gets backing despite All Black defeats
news.sum: All Blacks head coach Dave Rennie has received the unequivocal backing of his bosses at New Zealand Rugby.

news.t: Ireland have 'a full squad of fit bodies' for Wallabies
news.sum: While head coach Andy Farrell will be sweating on the availability of his captain Dan Sheehan for this week's final Nations Championship outing, the Ireland head coach has no new injuries to contend with ahead of the mee

news.t: 'Right on time' - Kildunne on Quins exit stories
news.sum: England and Bristol Bears full-back Ellie Kildunne makes a pointed reference to reports that poor time-keeping was behind her Harlequins exit.

news.t: McLeod shows quality in two-try Exeter debut
news.sum: Exeter coach Ross McMillan says Dallas McLeod showed his quality as he scored two tries on his Chiefs debut.

news.t: Duffy: World Cup thoughts may impact Australia selection
news.sum: Ireland head coach Andy Farrell could opt against wholesale changes for Australia on Friday night with next year's World Cup in mind, according to former Irish international Gavin Duffy.

news.t: South Africa win 'sets us up nicely' - Farrell
news.sum: Ireland head coach Andy Farrell says his side's victory over South Africa "sets us up nicely" for the the countdown to next year's World Cup.

news.t: Who should Wales pick for autumn finale v Japan?
news.sum: The choices facing Steve Tandy as the Wales head coach gets set to rotate his side for the Nations Championship finale against Japan.

news.t: WRU to discuss Anglo-Welsh move at crucial summit
news.sum: Welsh Rugby Union chief executive Abi Tierney says the prospect of Welsh clubs joining an expanded English league will be discussed in January.

news.t: Sheehan may miss Australia game after card changed to red
news.sum: Dan Sheehan is in danger of missing Ireland's Nations Championship play-off with Australia on Friday after seeing a yellow card he picked up against South Africa upgraded to a red.

news.t: Ireland deliver reminder they can still mix with the best
news.sum: There is a lot of road to be travelled between now and the World Cup, but after two years of struggling to land a blow on the game's Big Three, they have reminded themselves they can still mix it with the best, writes Ne

news.t: Sheehan was great at number eight - Van der Flier
news.sum: Ireland's Josh van der Flier pays tribute to Dan Sheehan who played in an unfamilar role of number eight in the Nations Championship win over South Africa.

news.t: England will not get carried away by beating All Blacks
news.sum: In his latest BBC Sport column, England World Cup winner Matt Dawson reflects on Steve Borthwick's side's record win over New Zealand and previews the final round of Nations Championship fixtures.

news.t: Did Springboks win change the narrative for Ireland?
news.sum: After a 20-17 win on Saturday, did Ireland's victory over South Africa change the narrative for Andy Farrell's side?

news.t: Scotland must let promising McConnell loose against Pumas
news.sum: Scotland head into their Nations Championship finale against Argentina on a high and should unleash Liam McConnell on the Pumas after his hat-trick against Japan, writes Tom English.

news.t: Keenan delighted after 'a great step forward' for Ireland
news.sum: 50-cap Ireland star Hugo Keenan has said that Ireland's heart-stopping 20-17 win over South Africa was a major milestone and the game they had targeted entering the window.

news.t: France thrash Argentina to reach Nations Championship final
news.sum: France beat Argentina 45-17 in Paris to set up a clash with South Africa in the Nations Championship final at the Allianz Stadium.

news.t: Ireland and Australia to battle for fifth next Friday
news.sum: Ireland will battle it out with Australia for fifth place in the inaugural Nations Championship next Friday night at Twickenham.

news.t: Highlights: Wallabies edge Wales in Cardiff
news.sum: Watch the best of the action as Australia edge Wales in Cardiff

news.t: Nations Championship finals weekend - who plays who?
news.sum: France will play South Africa in the inaugural Nations Championship final on 29 November - see the confirmed fixtures for finals weekend.

news.t: South Africa coaches deny communicating with Erasmus
news.sum: South Africa's coaching staff denied suggestions they were receiving instructions from suspended head coach Rassie Erasmus during Saturday's 20-17 defeat to Ireland in Dublin.

news.t: Farrell defends Prendergast after SA camp comments
news.sum: Ireland head coach Andy Farrell praises Sam Prendergast's performance in Saturday's victory over South Africa and expresses his displeasure at the Springboks' comments about the fly-half during the week.

news.t: Farrell: 'It's a big night for everyone who's Irish'
news.sum: Andy Farrell believes his side's nail-biting win against South Africa is a major "stepping stone" ahead of next year's World Cup.

news.t: Ireland remind themselves that the best are beatable
news.sum: Ireland put a string of deflating losses against the world's best teams behind them with a hard-fought 20-17 win over South Africa in Dublin.

news.t: Rugby Union Weekly: Record-breaking win for England against New Zealand
news.sum: The winning margin of 25 points is England's biggest ever against New Zealand

news.t: Ireland v South Africa ratings: Baloucoune stars at Aviva
news.sum: After six defeats on the spin to the apparent three best sides in the world, Ireland ended their slump in a nail-biting Nations Championship clash in Dublin. Here's how RTÉ Sport rated the players.

news.t: Farrell reacts to Ireland's win over South Africa
news.sum: Ireland head coach Andy Farrell reacts to his side's 20-17 win over world champions South Africa in the Nations Championship in Dublin.

news.t: Rassie watchalong: Radio silence and a lesson in kinesics
news.sum: Suspended South Africa head coach Rassie Erasmus held a unique watchalong as his side lost to Ireland at Aviva Stadium, but it maybe wasn't exactly what those who signed up were expecting.

news.t: Highlights: Ireland hang on to beat South Africa
news.sum: Watch highlights as Ireland hang on to beat world champions South Africa 20-17 in a thrilling Nations Championship game in Dublin.

news.t: Ireland dig deep to see off Springboks in Aviva epic
news.sum: As they often tend to, Ireland and South Africa produced another sensational arm-wrestle, and this time it was Ireland who held out to win a gripping Nations Championship clash at Aviva Stadium.

news.t: Ireland beat world champions South Africa in thriller
news.sum: Ireland exact revenge on world champions South Africa with a thrilling win in Dublin after England's victory over New Zealand dashes Andy Farrell's side's hopes of reaching next weekend's Nations Championship final.

news.t: England beat New Zealand by record margin
news.sum: England stun New Zealand, beating the three-time world champions by 25 points - compounding the All Blacks' disappointment after their loss to Wales last week.

news.t: Nations Championship wrap: England thrash All Blacks
news.sum: England thoroughly outplayed New Zealand in a 37-12 win at Twickenham as a record victory margin over the All Blacks and a bonus point gave them a chance of making next weekend's Nations Championship final.

news.t: Nations Championship: Ireland 20-17 South Africa recap
news.sum: Ireland have deated South Africa in a thriller in Dublin.

news.t: 'We backed ourselves' - Ireland rewarded for risks
news.sum: On two separate occasions in the first half of last night's win against South Africa, Ireland made bold, attacking calls, turning down relatively straightforward shots at goal in favour of going for the jugular.

news.t: Ireland XV ease to nine-try victory over Fiji Latui
news.sum: Ireland XV eased to a nine-try victory over Fijian Latui after a scarcely believable contest at Virgin Media Park.

news.t: South Africa continue to lament Prendergast decision
news.sum: South Africa assistant coach Mzwandile Stick declared "no one is going to break us" as he backed under-fire head coach Rassie Erasmus and criticised the decision to clear Ireland's Sam Prendergast to play.
